title: Starfall Site
description: A field of fresh stellar debris stretches before you, each fragment still pulsing with fading cosmic light. The ground is scorched in concentric rings where the largest pieces struck, and the air tastes of ozone and stardust.

choices.label: Gather the stardust
choices.description: Scoop up the luminous powder that coats every surface of the impact zone.

outcomes.text: The stardust is thick here, coating your gloves in golden light. You fill your pouches easily.
Beneath the dust layer you find veins of void silk, the cosmic fabric formed when starlight weaves with shadow.
A dormant fragment suddenly flares to life as you disturb it. The blast of cosmic energy sends you staggering backward.

choices.label: Pry out embedded crystals
choices.description: Small prismatic crystals formed where the cosmic heat fused with the earth.

outcomes.text: The fused crystals pop free with satisfying cracks. Each one refracts the starlight beautifully.
The crystals come loose along with some coins melted into the scorched earth by the impact.
Your prying awakens something in the crater. A creature formed of living starfire rises from the debris, crackling with fury.

choices.label: Leave the site
choices.description: The residual energy makes your teeth ache. You decide not to linger.

outcomes.text: You give the scorched impact zone a wide berth. The pulsing fragments watch you go with dying light.
